quotes.speaker: Javonte Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Javonte Green on his role and the origin of his nickname
quotes.excerpt: my role is, you know, tonight, you know, just going out there and changing the energy of the game
quotes.quote: I guess, you know, my role is, you know, tonight, you know, just going out there and changing the energy of the game and just being prepared to do whatever it takes to help my team win. And I feel like that is that is what I brought tonight and the nickname Woo, nobody knows where it came from. And I'm sorry, but we've been asking the same question for, I'll say six years now. Nobody knows, my mom doesn't know, my grandma doesn't know, nobody knows where it came from. I wish I had an answer for you.
